==Usage==
Place {<nowiki />{TCWRetcon}} onto [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] Clone Wars articles for which there are unresolved continuity errors.

===Optional parameter===
To specify an individual product (or products) affected by ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'', a parameter can be used to note the affected material:

 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>TCWRetcon|'''PRODUCT'''}}

Example:

 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>TCWRetcon|<nowiki>''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</nowiki>}}

{{TCWRetcon|''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''}}

===="cw" parameter====
If the article's information is not specifically affected by the revised Clone Wars timeline, the "'''cw'''" parameter can be used to specify that as well.

 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>TCWRetcon|'''PRODUCT'''|cw=y}}

Example:

 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>TCWRetcon|<nowiki>''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</nowiki>|cw=y}}

{{TCWRetcon|''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''|cw=y}}
